name: waterml
label: OGC WaterML 2.0
description: Water quality and hydrological data standard — for water management applications

table_notes.waterml_monitoring_point: Physical or virtual location where water observations are collected, such as a river gauge, well, or lake sampling station.
table_notes.waterml_observed_property: Reference catalogue of measurable water properties (e.g. pH, dissolved oxygen, discharge) with units and definition URIs.
table_notes.waterml_observation: Individual measurement events linking a monitoring point to an observed property with quality and censoring metadata.
table_notes.waterml_time_series: Summary of an ordered sequence of observations at a monitoring point for a specific property, including temporal extent and collection method.

waterml_monitoring_point.name: id
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Unique identifier for the monitoring point (UUID, stable across systems)

waterml_monitoring_point.name: name
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Human-readable name of the monitoring point (e.g. 'Sacramento River at Freeport')

waterml_monitoring_point.name: local_id
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Agency-assigned local identifier (e.g. USGS site number, unique within operator)

waterml_monitoring_point.name: point_type
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Classification of the monitoring point (e.g. stream, well, lake, estuary, spring)

waterml_monitoring_point.name: geo_position
waterml_monitoring_point.description: WGS84 geographic coordinates of the monitoring point; enables spatial proximity queries

waterml_monitoring_point.name: elevation_m
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Elevation of the monitoring point above vertical datum, in metres

waterml_monitoring_point.name: vertical_datum
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Reference datum for elevation (e.g. NAVD88, EGM2008, local mean sea level)

waterml_monitoring_point.name: responsible_party
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Organisation or agency responsible for operating and maintaining this monitoring point

waterml_monitoring_point.name: is_active
waterml_monitoring_point.description: Whether this monitoring point is currently collecting observations

waterml_observed_property.name: id
waterml_observed_property.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the observed property

waterml_observed_property.name: identifier
waterml_observed_property.description: Globally unique URI for this property (e.g. http://environment.data.gov.au/water/id/waterquality/ph)

waterml_observed_property.name: name
waterml_observed_property.description: Short human-readable name of the measured property (e.g. 'Water Temperature', 'Dissolved Oxygen')

waterml_observed_property.name: definition_url
waterml_observed_property.description: Canonical URL pointing to the property definition in a controlled vocabulary or ontology

waterml_observed_property.name: unit_of_measure
waterml_observed_property.description: Unit symbol for observation values (e.g. mg/L, m³/s, °C, pH units)

waterml_observed_property.name: description
waterml_observed_property.description: Full narrative description of what the property measures and any measurement conventions

waterml_observation.name: id
waterml_observation.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key; BIGSERIAL supports high-volume time-series ingestion

waterml_observation.name: monitoring_point_id
waterml_observation.description: References waterml_monitoring_point — the location where this measurement was taken

waterml_observation.name: observed_property_id
waterml_observation.description: References waterml_observed_property — what physical/chemical quantity was measured

waterml_observation.name: phenomenon_time
waterml_observation.description: Timestamp at which the observed phenomenon occurred (always store in UTC)

waterml_observation.name: result_time
waterml_observation.description: Timestamp when the result was produced or published (may differ from phenomenon_time)

waterml_observation.name: value
waterml_observation.description: Numeric measurement result in the unit defined by the observed property

waterml_observation.name: quality_code
waterml_observation.description: Data quality flag using WaterML/CUAHSI vocabulary (e.g. Good, Suspect, Poor, Missing)

waterml_observation.name: processing_level
waterml_observation.description: Level of data processing applied: raw, quality-controlled, derived, or modelled

waterml_observation.name: censor_code
waterml_observation.description: Censoring indicator per CUAHSI standard: nc=not censored, lt=below detection, gt=above range

waterml_time_series.name: id
waterml_time_series.description: Unique identifier for this time series descriptor record

waterml_time_series.name: monitoring_point_id
waterml_time_series.description: References waterml_monitoring_point — the station associated with this time series

waterml_time_series.name: observed_property_id
waterml_time_series.description: References waterml_observed_property — the variable captured in this time series

waterml_time_series.name: start_time
waterml_time_series.description: Timestamp of the earliest observation in this time series

waterml_time_series.name: end_time
waterml_time_series.description: Timestamp of the most recent observation in this time series (NULL if ongoing)

waterml_time_series.name: count
waterml_time_series.description: Total number of observation records in this time series (used for completeness checks)

waterml_time_series.name: method
waterml_time_series.description: Measurement or derivation method (e.g. continuous sensor, grab sample, modelled output)

waterml_time_series.name: equipment
waterml_time_series.description: Instrument or sensor model used to collect the measurements (e.g. YSI EXO2, OTT Qliner)

short_description: Water quality and hydrological data standard — for water management applications
long_description: OGC WaterML 2.0 is the global standard for hydrological and water quality data exchange, from USGS stream gauges to EPA water quality monitoring.
when_to_use: Use for water utility systems, flood forecasting, or environmental monitoring. Required for EU WFD reporting to EEA and USGS NWIS integrations.
